## Evaluation

### Scores
| Dimension | Score | Reasoning |
|-----------|-------|-----------|
| Correctness (25%) | 7/10 | Tests use RTL and Vitest correctly with proper async patterns, userEvent, and accessibility queries. However, missing imports (mockItems, server, HttpResponse, http), incomplete test setup (MSW configuration), and some tests have placeholder comments instead of actual implementation. The core patterns are sound but not production-ready as-is. |
| Depth (25%) | 6/10 | Covers the requested areas (happy path, validation, error states, loading, accessibility, edge cases) but each section is thin. Only 1-2 tests per category when comprehensive coverage would require more. Missing: keyboard navigation, responsive behavior, price calculation verification, coupon codes, shipping options, state/zip validation, expiry/CVV handling, network timeout scenarios. |
| Quality (25%) | 7/10 | Well-organized with descriptive describe blocks. Test names are clear despite the thematic flourishes. Code is readable and follows RTL best practices (role queries, user-event). However, the thematic section names ("wolves walk through", "rabbits get caught") sacrifice some clarity for style. Missing setup/teardown boilerplate limits immediate usability. |
| Persona (25%) | 9/10 | Excellent Lorne Malvo embodiment. The cold, philosophical menace comes through clearly. Stage directions capture his unsettling stillness. The metaphors (wolves/rabbits, ice over chaos, civilization as veneer) are authentic to the character. Test section names cleverly tie to his worldview. The closing monologue perfectly captures his detached nihilism. |
| **WEIGHTED_TOTAL** | 72.5/100 | |

### Overall Assessment
A solid demonstration that successfully balances technical competence with strong character work. The test structure and RTL patterns are correct, but the suite lacks the depth and completeness needed for a truly "comprehensive" solution—several tests are skeletal or rely on undefined fixtures. The Lorne Malvo persona is the standout element, executed with genuine menace and thematic coherence that elevates the response beyond a dry technical exercise.
